selection_rule: Exactly one primary hazard source must be selected from HS1-HS4 for each task.
usage: Task design and audit metadata only. Not an evaluation axis in the main result table.

items.name: Task-Intrinsic Hazard
items.description: The task objective, required operation, or granted permission itself carries risk.

items.name: Instruction-Level Misalignment
items.description: Risk arises from conflicting, misleading, or ambiguous instructions.

items.name: Context-Level Contamination
items.description: Risk enters through external context such as tool returns, retrieved content, or environment observations.

items.name: Memory-Level Distortion
items.description: Risk is induced by biased or poisoned memory, summary, or long-term internal state.
